name: Rotation Wars
desc:
⚔️ Welcome to Rotation Wars!
Fight in close battles with cool weapons! (inspired by Earclacks' Weapon Balls)

✨ Use awesome weapons like Katana, Shield, Sword, Bow, and Shuriken.
💥 Battle friends in crazy, fun fights!
⭐ Level up and earn $ to get super strong weapons like the Execution’s Blade.
🎮 Play many modes: King of the Hill, Infection, Juggernaut, Duos, and Squads.
🔧 Fast updates, new weapons, and community votes!

Are you ready to spin, fight, and get OP? Join now!
